name: plainpad
description: 📓 Plainpad - Self Hosted Note Taking App
readme_summary: Plainpad is a self-hosted note-taking application built with PHP and React, offering users full ownership of their data. It emphasizes simplicity and stability, running on the user's own server.
primary_use_case: To provide a private and secure self-hosted solution for individuals and teams to manage their notes.
cover_image_prompt: A cozy, minimalist study room where a single, glowing notebook sits on a desk. The notebook is open, and from its pages, digital streams of organized thoughts and ideas are flowing outwards, forming neat, structured outlines and lists. Subtle elements like a small, stylized 'P' icon on the notebook and faint code snippets appearing on a nearby digital tablet connect it to the 'Plainpad' application. The overall mood is calm and productive, with soft, natural light illuminating the scene. The style should be a clean, 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clarity and a soothing color palette.

name: rip
description: Fuzzy find and kill processes from your terminal
readme_summary: Rip is a command-line tool written in Rust that allows users to fuzzy find and terminate processes running on their system. It provides an interactive interface to search for processes by name, sort them by various metrics like CPU, memory, or PID, and send signals (like KILL or TERM) to selected processes.
key_features: Sorting by CPU, memory, PID, name, and port
Live mode with auto-refreshing process list
Port listening mode to find processes by port number
Installation via Homebrew, Cargo, and Nix
primary_use_case: Interactively finding and terminating unwanted or problematic processes from the terminal using a fuzzy search interface.
cover_image_prompt: A digital gardener tending to a vibrant, overgrown garden of running processes represented as colorful, tangled vines. The gardener, holding a pair of glowing pruning shears labeled 'rip', is carefully selecting and snipping away specific vines (processes) that are consuming too much energy (CPU/memory) or are unwanted. Small, subtle UI elements resembling a terminal interface float around the gardener, showing process names and signals. The background is a clean, dark digital space, with the 'rip' name subtly integrated into a glowing tool or a digital tag. The overall mood is one of control and efficient management. Style: 3D isometric illustration with clean lines and a vibrant, yet organized color palette.

name: time-tracker-4-browser
description: A browser extension that helps you track time, analyze your habits and block addictive sites
readme_summary: Time Tracker - Web Habit Builder is a browser extension designed to help users understand and manage their online habits. It provides detailed tracking of website usage, analytical reports, website blocking, and focus tools like Pomodoro sessions, with cross-browser compatibility and data synchronization/backup options.
key_features: Track browsing time and visit counts
Detailed records and daily activity review
Dashboards, website analysis, and habit reports
Set website usage limits (daily, weekly, per-visit)
Page blocking when limits are reached
Data migration and record clearing tools
primary_use_case: Helping users understand, manage, and improve their browsing habits by tracking time spent on websites, setting limits, and blocking distracting sites.
cover_image_prompt: A digital hourglass with a glowing, translucent top half filled with website icons and a bottom half filled with focused, productive icons like a book and a lightbulb. A subtle digital stream of data flows from the website icons into the hourglass, representing tracking. The repository name 'Time Tracker' is subtly etched onto the base of the hourglass. The scene is set against a clean, minimalist background with soft, ambient lighting, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with vibrant, contrasting colors for the icons.

name: mana
description: *DEPRECATED* mana toolkit for wifi rogue AP attacks and MitM
readme_summary: The MANA Toolkit is a deprecated collection of tools designed for rogue access point (evilAP) attacks and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) scenarios. It includes modified hostapd for enhanced KARMA attacks and utilities for post-connection MitM operations.
key_features: Tools for offloading EAP credential cracking (crackapd)
Modifications for sslstrip and HSTS bypass
Installation scripts for Kali and Ubuntu
primary_use_case: Conducting rogue access point attacks and Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
cover_image_prompt: A mischievous, stylized Wi-Fi router in the foreground, subtly labeled 'MANA', is emitting a shimmering, invisible net that ensnares nearby digital devices like smartphones and laptops. The devices, initially glowing with a standard connection icon, are now subtly changing to a 'captive portal' symbol. In the background, a shadowy figure is observing this process on a minimalist screen displaying flowing data streams and a single, glowing 'MitM' indicator. The overall mood is one of subtle digital infiltration, rendered in a clean, modern flat design style with a limited color palette of blues, grays, and a single accent color for the 'captive portal' effect.

name: osx-and-ios-security-awesome
description: OSX and iOS related security tools
readme_summary: This repository is an 'Awesome List' curating a comprehensive collection of security-related tools specifically for macOS and iOS. It categorizes these tools for forensic analysis, system auditing, malware detection, and security configuration management.
key_features: Curated list of macOS security tools
Curated list of iOS security tools
Categorization of tools by function (forensics, auditing, persistence, etc.)
Links to external repositories and projects
Includes tools for binary whitelisting, code injection, and disassembling
primary_use_case: To serve as a centralized, curated resource for security professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts looking for tools to analyze, audit, and secure macOS and iOS systems.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant digital detective, wearing a stylized macOS/iOS themed trench coat, stands before a complex network of glowing data streams representing system processes. The detective holds a magnifying glass that reveals hidden vulnerabilities and malicious code snippets within the streams, which are highlighted in red. Clean, organized data flows through green pathways, indicating secure operations. Subtle UI elements showing security metrics and code snippets are integrated into the background. The repository name 'osx-and-ios-security-awesome' is subtly etched onto a digital tablet the detective holds. The scene is rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a dark, high-tech color palette and dramatic, focused lighting.

name: Interlace
description: Easily turn single threaded command line applications into a fast, multi-threaded application with CIDR and glob support.
readme_summary: Interlace is a Python-based tool designed to enhance single-threaded command-line applications by enabling multi-threading. It simplifies the process of running these applications concurrently against multiple targets, supporting CIDR notation for IP ranges and glob patterns for file matching.
primary_use_case: To accelerate and scale the execution of single-threaded command-line tools, particularly in security and network enumeration tasks, by allowing them to run concurrently against a large number of targets defined using CIDR or glob patterns.
cover_image_prompt: A powerful, stylized loom weaving multiple threads of light simultaneously. Each thread represents a command-line application being executed. The threads converge on a complex network map, with each connection point being a target being processed. Input targets are shown as a stream of data flowing into the loom, and successful outputs are visualized as glowing nodes on the map. Subtle UI elements showing progress bars and target lists are integrated into the loom's design. The overall mood is one of efficient, high-speed processing and automation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a dark, tech-focused color palette and glowing accents.
